column1: # OWASP ZAP rule levels for zap-baseline.py and zap-api-scan.py (IO-266).
# Columns, tab separated: rule id, FAIL | WARN | IGNORE, name.
# FAIL on medium and high, WARN on low. ZAP treats a rule that is not listed as
# a WARN, so check.py also fails any medium or high alert that has no IGNORE line.
# The signed-in scan (signed-in.yaml) runs the passive rules at their defaults and
# is gated by check.py alone. Every IGNORE needs a reason in a comment line right above it ("# reason: ...").
